description: Check one sealed claim by tenant plus seq or hash. Before reveal time only the receipt shows; after it the claim text and salt are included. With a nonce it returns the receipt of a paid answer instead: the sha256 of the answer bytes, its sequence number and, once sealed, the opBNB batch transaction and Merkle path

hash.description: sha256 of the sealed claim, 64 hex characters. Example: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08

nonce.description: Payment nonce of a paid answer, the nonce field of its receipt (x402: 0x and 64 hex characters). Example: 0x7d3c8a2f5e9b1d4c6a0f8e2b3c5d7a9f1e4b6c8d0a2f4e6b8c1d3e5f7a9b0c2d

seq.description: Sequence number of the claim in the tenant stream, whole number from 1. Example: 3

tenant.description: Tenant identity: the paying wallet address in lower case, or the numeric key id of a ChainHelix subscription. Example: 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead

name: attest_status
